docs.title: Workload
docs.text: Traffic comes at two fidelities. A shape describes it as distributions and lives in the catalog. A trace is a captured file of real requests. A replay names a load generator's trace-replay scenario over a pinned corpus. A scenario's workload key binds exactly one of the three.

docs.title: Binding
docs.text:
The value of a scenario's workload key.

workload:
  shape: chatbot
Key Type Required Meaning shape string one of the three A workload shape under workloads/ in the catalog. trace mapping one of the three A reference to a captured trace, below. replay mapping one of the three A trace-replay scenario, below.

A binding with more than one key, or with none, is invalid. To pose a question with no traffic, omit workload from the scenario instead.

docs.title: Trace
docs.text:
workload:
  trace:
    data: traces/agentic-run.csv
    rows: 1048576
    header:
      trace_version: 3
      time_unit: microseconds
      mode: real
      server:
        type: vllm
        tensor_parallel: 8
        gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9
      goodput_slo_targets:
        critical: {ttft_ms: 500, itl_ms: 50, e2e_ms: 30000}

The rows of a trace can number in the millions, so they stay in the file that data names and never appear in the scenario. The scenario holds the path, an optional digest and row count, and the small header that says how to read the file.

Key Type Required Meaning data string yes Path to the per-request data CSV. sha256 string no Hex digest of the data file, 64 characters. rows integer no Expected number of rows in the data file. Not negative. header mapping yes The trace header, below. token_blocks mapping no The per-request block-hash sidecar, below. Lets a replay reproduce prefix-cache hits exactly rather than approximate them from prefix groups. category string no The workload category that selects an acceptance profile, such as coding. thinking string no Whether the model reasons: on or off. Selects the profile with category. acceptance mapping no The trace's own measured acceptance, an inline value. Outranks the registry's. routing mapping no The traffic's own measured routing imbalance, an inline value. Outranks the registry's.

docs.title: token_blocks
docs.text: Key Type Required Meaning path string yes Path to the block-hash sidecar. sha256 string yes Its digest, 64 lowercase hex characters.

docs.title: header
docs.text: Key Type Required Meaning trace_version integer yes The trace format version the data file was written in. At least 1. time_unit string yes Unit of the file's timestamp columns. One of the time units. mode string yes How the trace was produced. One of the trace modes. workload_seed integer no The workload generator's seed, when one was recorded. A seed of 0 is a real seed, distinct from absence. server mapping no Configuration of the server the trace came from, below. goodput_slo_targets mapping no Latency targets per SLO class, keyed by class name, below. Class names are free.

docs.title: header.server
docs.text:
Every key is optional. The server is the one that produced the trace, which need not be the deployment being simulated.

Key Type Required Meaning type string no The serving engine, such as vllm. model string no The model it served. tensor_parallel integer no Tensor-parallel width. Not negative. max_num_seqs integer no Sequence cap. Not negative. block_size integer no KV block size. Not negative. gpu_memory_utilization number no Fraction of GPU memory, in [0, 1]. Zero means unrecorded. max_model_len integer no Context length. Not negative.

docs.title: header.goodput_slo_targets.<class>
docs.text:
Thresholds in milliseconds. Zero on a dimension leaves it unconstrained, but a class must constrain at least one.

Key Type Required Meaning ttft_ms number no Time to first token. Not negative. itl_ms number no Inter-token latency. Not negative. e2e_ms number no End-to-end latency. Not negative.

docs.title: Replay
docs.text:
A replay states the run a load generator makes, not the requests it sends: a named scenario, the harness release it reproduces, the corpus it reads, and every knob the scenario fixes. The corpus stays in its repository. How sessions are rebuilt and dispatched is the harness's behaviour, which a simulator implements; this is the contract it is checked against. Today one scenario is transcribed: aiperf 0.12.0's inferencex-agentx-mvp, agentic replay of SemiAnalysis's Weka Claude Code traces.

workload:
  replay:
    scenario: inferencex-agentx-mvp
    harness_version: 0.12.0
    corpus:
      loader: semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k
      format: weka-trace-v7
      encoding: jsonl
      source:
        huggingface: semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k
        revision: 8fecd2fc56694469f758f0afbbb6335ad3043740
        file: traces.jsonl
        split: train
      sha256: e39cd2ff3eba21d4a3664be51da743ac3d2149a1933898cafc7bfeac8147eeef
    concurrency: 64
    random_seed: 42
    benchmark_duration_s: 900
    grace_period_s: 30
    max_context_length: max_model_len
    category: coding
    thinking: "on"

A replay arm takes one of two forms. Inline, it states the whole definition beside the lane count, as above. As a reference, it names a catalog replay workload and states only the run's choices:

workload:
  replay:
    workload: workload-replay
    concurrency: 32
    grace_period_s: 1800
Key Type Required Meaning workload string no A catalog replay workload under workloads/, by file name. Set, the binding may state only concurrency, random_seed, benchmark_duration_s, grace_period_s, max_context_length and acceptance, which override the entry's; ValidateAgainstCatalog loads the entry and ResolveReplay merges the two. concurrency integer yes Session-tree lanes, at least 1. Subagents run beside their parent without taking a lane. One value: a scenario run is not a sweep. It is the run's choice, so a catalog entry does not state it.

The other keys are the definition's, below.

docs.title: The definition
docs.text:
A key the scenario locks may be omitted, and then takes the value the harness applies; a stated value the scenario's validator would refuse is an error. Citations are to aiperf 0.12.0, common/scenario/inferencex_agentx_mvp.py and common/scenario/validator.py.

Key Type Required Meaning scenario string yes One of the replay scenarios. harness_version string yes The harness release the replay reproduces. 0.12.0 for inferencex-agentx-mvp. corpus mapping yes The traces, below. random_seed integer no Seeds lane snapshots and prompt content. Omitted, 42. (aiperf alone would draw a random seed.) benchmark_duration_s number no The sending window, at least 900. Omitted, 1800. grace_period_s number no How long requests in flight at the window's end may finish. Not negative; .inf waits indefinitely. Omitted, 30. max_context_length integer or max_model_len no Drops every trace whose recorded peak prompt plus output exceeds it. max_model_len is the deployment's resolved context length. Omitted, no filter. cache_bust string no Must be first_turn_prefix, its default: one marker per session tree. system_idle_gap_cap_s number no Must be 10, its default: when nothing is in flight, pending timers are pulled in so the system idles at most this long. trajectory_start mapping no The window of each trace's span a lane's snapshot is drawn from, below. Omitted, the whole span. warmup mapping no How the server is primed before profiling, below. Omitted, synthesized. split_flattened_agents boolean no Whether agent chains a capture flattened are split by hash-prefix detection. Omitted, true. streaming boolean no Must be true. ignore_eos boolean no Must be true: every request generates its recorded output length. ignore_trace_delays boolean no Must be false. synthesis_max_isl integer no Must be unset: the scenario forbids input truncation. trace_idle_gap_cap_s number no Positive, or unset. A per-trajectory idle watchdog (the InferenceX fork's --trace-idle-gap-cap-seconds); the scenario's default leaves it off. inter_turn_delay_cap_s number no Must be unset: per-turn delays are uncapped. category string no The workload category that selects an acceptance profile. thinking string no on or off. Selects the profile with category. acceptance mapping no The run's own acceptance, an inline value. routing mapping no The traffic's own measured routing imbalance, an inline value. Outranks the registry's.

docs.title: Catalog replay workload
docs.text:
A catalog file under workloads/ whose top-level key is replay: is a replay workload rather than a shape. It holds a definition, with no lane count, and is named by its file. It may carry _comment keys at its top level, as a shape may. LoadCatalogWorkload reads either form, LoadWorkload reads shapes only, and validate-catalog validates both.

workloads/workload-replay.yaml
_comment: >
  aiperf 0.12.0's inferencex-agentx-mvp over the 256k-capped SemiAnalysis Weka corpus.
  The lane count is the run's choice, so it is stated where the workload is bound.
replay:
  scenario: inferencex-agentx-mvp
  harness_version: 0.12.0
  corpus:
    loader: semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k
    format: weka-trace-v7
    encoding: jsonl
    source:
      huggingface: semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k
      revision: 8fecd2fc56694469f758f0afbbb6335ad3043740
      file: traces.jsonl
      split: train
    sha256: e39cd2ff3eba21d4a3664be51da743ac3d2149a1933898cafc7bfeac8147eeef
  benchmark_duration_s: 900
  max_context_length: max_model_len
  category: coding
  thinking: "on"

A scenario cannot bind a replay workload as shape:; ValidateAgainstCatalog says so.

docs.title: corpus
docs.text: Key Type Required Meaning loader string yes The harness loader or public-dataset alias, such as semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k. One the scenario accepts. Each alias reads the repository aiperf's plugins.yaml fixes for it, and source.huggingface must name that one. The two rolling aliases, semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_with_subagents and its _256k variant, track whatever corpus is current and draw a warning. weka_trace, a local directory, cannot pin the corpus and is refused, and weka_hf may only read semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126. format string yes One of the corpus formats. encoding string yes One of the corpus encodings. source mapping yes Where it is published, below. sha256 string yes Hex digest of the corpus file, 64 characters: its Hugging Face LFS object id. Required because aiperf reads the default branch, not revision, so only the digest ties a run to the bytes it read.

docs.title: corpus.source
docs.text: Key Type Required Meaning huggingface string yes The dataset repository, owner/name. revision string yes The commit the corpus was observed at. A record, not a pin: aiperf 0.12.0's Weka loaders set no hf_revision and read the default branch (dataset/loader/base_hf_dataset.py:28, 77). file string no The corpus file's path in the repository. split string no The dataset split.

docs.title: trajectory_start
docs.text:
Each bound is a fraction of a trace's span, from its first request's start to its last's, in [0, 1]. The scenario fills [0, 1]; unlike its locks, aiperf honours a stated window.

Key Type Required Meaning min_ratio number no Lower bound. Omitted, 0. max_ratio number no Upper bound, at least min_ratio. Omitted, 1.

docs.title: warmup
docs.text: Key Type Required Meaning mode string yes One of the warmup modes. duration_s number cache_pressure, with one of these How long the accelerated cache-pressure warmup runs. No other mode takes it. requests_per_lane integer cache_pressure, with one of these Request-bounded cache-pressure warmup: each lane sends this many extra one-token warmup requests. Mutually exclusive with duration_s; no other mode takes it.

docs.title: Shape
docs.text:
A catalog file under workloads/, named by its file; a name key in it is rejected. This is the catalog's chatbot:

workloads/chatbot.yaml
prefix_tokens: 0
prompt:
  tokens: 256
  tokens_stdev: 100
  tokens_min: 2
  tokens_max: 800
output:
  tokens: 256
  tokens_stdev: 100
  tokens_min: 1
  tokens_max: 1024
Key Type Required Meaning prefix_tokens integer no Prefix length shared across requests. Zero means none. prompt mapping yes Prompt length distribution, below. output mapping yes Output length distribution, below. category string no The workload category that selects an acceptance profile, such as coding. thinking string no Whether the model reasons: on or off. Selects the profile with category. acceptance mapping no The traffic's own measured acceptance, an inline value. Outranks the registry's. routing mapping no The traffic's own measured routing imbalance, an inline value. Outranks the registry's.

docs.title: prompt and output
docs.text:
Key Type Required Meaning tokens integer yes Mean length in tokens. Positive. tokens_stdev integer no Standard deviation. tokens_min integer no Lower bound. Zero means unset. tokens_max integer no Upper bound. Zero means unset.

A file may also carry _comment and _comment_* keys, at the top level and inside prompt and output. They are discarded when the file is loaded.

docs.title: Checks
docs.text:
A binding is invalid unless it sets exactly one of shape, trace and replay. A trace reference is invalid if

  • data is empty, rows is negative, or sha256 is present and is not 64 hex digits;
  • trace_version is less than 1;
  • time_unit or mode is empty or not in its vocabulary;
  • a server count is negative, or gpu_memory_utilization is not finite or lies outside [0, 1];
  • an SLO class name is empty, a target is negative or not finite, or a class sets no target.

A trace reference or a shape is also invalid if a stated category is malformed, thinking is not on or off, or acceptance is not a valid inline value.

A replay is invalid if

  • scenario or harness_version is empty or not transcribed, or concurrency is less than 1;
  • benchmark_duration_s is not finite, negative, or below 900;
  • grace_period_s is negative or NaN;
  • cache_bust is other than first_turn_prefix, or system_idle_gap_cap_s other than 10;
  • a trajectory_start bound lies outside [0, 1], or min_ratio exceeds max_ratio;
  • warmup.mode is unknown; a cache_pressure warmup does not state exactly one of duration_s or requests_per_lane, or states a non-positive one; or either is stated for another mode;
  • streaming or ignore_eos is false, ignore_trace_delays true, synthesis_max_isl or inter_turn_delay_cap_s is set, or trace_idle_gap_cap_s is non-positive;
  • the corpus loader is empty or not one the scenario accepts, is weka_trace, or is weka_hf on another repository, or an alias on a repository other than its own; format or encoding is unknown; the repository is not owner/name; revision is empty; or sha256 is missing or not 64 hex digits;
  • its acceptance terms are invalid, as for a trace.

A replay that references a catalog workload is invalid if it states anything but the run's choices, or concurrency is less than 1. ValidateAgainstCatalog reports a reference whose entry is missing, is a shape, or merges to an invalid replay.

A shape is invalid if

  • prefix_tokens is negative, or longer than the mean prompt;
  • a mean tokens is less than 1;
  • tokens_stdev or tokens_min is negative;
  • tokens_min exceeds tokens_max, or the mean lies outside [tokens_min, tokens_max] where those are set.

A shape built in Go must also have a name; one loaded from a file always does, since the loader takes it from the file name.

Source: spec/workload.
